headline: Profit growth accelerates across income and equity lines
summary_short: Blackstone reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of $1.54, up 85.5% q/q and 57.1% y/y, with revenue of $5.044 billion (+39.4% q/q, +35.9% y/y) and net income of $1.229 billion (+89.2% q/q, +60.8% y/y).
summary_long: EPS (basic and diluted) reached $1.54, up 85.5% q/q from $0.83 and 57.1% y/y from $0.98. Revenue was $5.044 billion (+39.4% q/q, +35.9% y/y) and pre-tax income $2.808 billion (+93.0% q/q, +46.6% y/y). Net income rose to $1.229 billion (+89.2% q/q, +60.8% y/y; prior-period net income figures sourced from Yahoo timeseries rather than SEC-verbatim). Total cash was $2.507 billion (+2.4% q/q, +12.1% y/y) against long-term debt of $13.319 billion (-0.7% q/q, +9.7% y/y). Shareholders' equity was $9.015 billion (+7.7% q/q, +7.9% y/y) on 799.9 million weighted diluted shares (+1.7% q/q, +2.2% y/y). All figures are shard-verified KPIs; no drivers or guidance assessed at kpi-only depth.
